ITEM 1 | Dense heap of wilted, dark green leafy greens with thin stems, glossy and moist-looking with a slight sheen, leaves folded and tangled, covering roughly 45% of the plate in a mound about 3 cm tall, sitting on the plate centre-left | 110
ITEM 2 | Long slender bright green stalks, about 0.6 cm thick and 12 to 15 cm long, smooth skin, lying across the top of the greens and partly on the plate surface, a few pieces with cut ends | 35
ITEM 3 | Single loose leaf fragment, flat dark green, about 4 cm long, lying separately on the plate lower left, dry-edged | 3
ITEM 4 | Small piece of bright red tomato-like flesh, about 2 cm across, partly tucked under the greens near the upper right, moist surface | 5
ITEM 5 | Small brown oval piece, about 1.5 cm long, matte and slightly wrinkled, sitting at the lower edge of the greens, possibly a seed or nut fragment | 3
